oneLiner: 同种电荷相斥、异种相吸；F=k·q₁q₂/r²。
oneLinerEn: Like charges repel, unlike attract; F=k·q₁q₂/r².
detail: 库仑定律 F = k·q₁q₂/r² 有两条前提：真空中、点电荷。r 趋于零时公式趋于无穷大是假象——带电体已有尺寸、电荷会重新分布，公式早已失效；反过来，均匀带电球体在球外等效于电荷全在球心，这才让它能用于天体与微观模型。k = 9×10⁹ N·m²/C² 看着比引力常数 G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 大了二十个数量级，但两者量纲不同、不能直接比大小；能比的是同一对粒子之间的两种力：两个质子相距同距时电力约是万有引力的 10³⁶ 倍（两个电子更达 4×10⁴² 倍），所以微观世界引力彻底靠边、原子结构全由电力决定；天体则几乎等量正负、抵消得干干净净，长程只相加不抵消的引力反倒在宇宙尺度上独裁（与力学万有引力条同口径）。电量必须一份一份来：e = 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C 由密立根 1909 年起的油滴实验钉成实验事实，任何宏观带电体的电量都是它的整数倍。起电只有三条路——摩擦（得失电子）、接触、感应；感应起电的妙处在于不必碰触：先让导体靠近带电体、再在远端接地、最后断开，导体就带上了异种电荷。两个完全相同的导体球接触后电量均分，但不相同的两球并不一定平分，这是题目的常见陷阱。力的方向永远沿两球心的连线，多个电荷同时存在时求某个电荷的合力就得逐对算完再做矢量相加，电力同样满足叠加原理。式中 k 为静电力常量，q₁、q₂ 为两点电荷电量，r 为间距。
detailEn: Coulomb's law F = k q₁q₂/r² carries two conditions: vacuum, and point charges. The infinity the formula predicts as r goes to zero is an illusion - real charged bodies have size and their charge redistributes, so the equation has long since stopped applying; conversely a uniformly charged sphere acts from outside as if all its charge sat at its centre, which is what lets the law be used on planets and on model atoms. k = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C² looks some twenty orders of magnitude above G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹, but the units differ and the constants cannot simply be compared - what can be compared is the two forces between the same pair of particles: at any equal separation the electric push between two protons is about 10³⁶ times their gravitational pull (about 4 × 10⁴² for two electrons), so gravity drops out of micro physics and atomic structure is entirely electric. Bulk matter holds nearly equal amounts of plus and minus and cancels almost perfectly, which is why the long-ranged, never-cancelling gravity rules the astronomical scale instead. Charge comes in whole units: e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, fixed as experimental fact by Millikan's oil-drop work from 1909, and any macroscopic charge is a whole multiple of it. There are only three ways to charge something - rubbing (electrons gained or lost), touching, and induction. The trick of induction is that nothing need be touched: bring a conductor near a charged body, ground its far side, then lift the ground, and the body is left with the opposite charge. Two identical conducting spheres share their total equally on contact, but two unequal ones need not, a standing trap in problems. The force always lies along the line of the two centres, and with several charges present the net force on any one of them means computing every pair and then adding vectors - electric forces obey superposition like everything else. Symbols: k the electrostatic constant, q₁ and q₂ the two point charges, r their separation.

oneLiner: 电荷周围存在电场；E=F/q，方向为正电荷受力方向。
oneLinerEn: A charge creates an electric field; E=F/q, directed as a positive test charge is pushed.
detail: 电场是客观存在的特殊物质：没有媒质边界、不需接触就能施力，且满足叠加原理——空间某点的场强是各个源电荷单独所致的矢量和，与那里放不放置试探电荷无关。E = F/q 取的是正电荷的受力方向，所以负电荷受力与之恰好反向，这是第一处易错。两条公式外形相似而身份完全不同：E = F/q 是定义式（比值法），对任何电场都成立、却答不了“这场是谁造的”；E = kQ/r² 是点电荷的决定式，只适用于点电荷（或均匀带电球体外部），但真正把电量与距离带了进来。二者不能混用，这是第二处易错。电场线是为可视化而画的假线，空间里并没有；静电场的电场线自正电荷出发、终止于负电荷，不闭合、不相交（磁感线则闭合，见磁场条），线上某点的切线方向才是该点场强方向，疏密表大小。由此得到一个硬结论：带电粒子的运动轨迹一般不沿电场线，只有在电场线是直线且粒子初速为零或初速与线共线时两者才重合，这是第三处易错。点电荷的场是辐射状的直线；等量同种电荷在中点场强为零而电势不为零，等量异种电荷在中垂线上处处场强不为零而那条中垂线恰好是等势线，这两组对照几乎每届考试都要考。匀强电场最规整的实例就是一对平行正对带电板之间（靠边缘处弯曲，称边缘效应）。粒子的电量与质量之比叫比荷，它决定粒子在给定场里响应得多快，是质谱与回旋加速器一切讨论的入口。式中 E 为电场强度，F 为试探电荷受力，q 为试探电荷电量。
detailEn: An electric field is objective matter of a special kind: it has no boundary of medium, pushes without contact, and obeys superposition - the field at a point is the vector sum of what each source charge would produce alone, and it does not care whether a test charge happens to sit there. E = F/q takes the direction of the force on a positive charge, so a negative charge is pushed the opposite way; that is trap one. Two formulas look alike but have different identities: E = F/q is the defining ratio, valid for any field yet silent about who made it, while E = kQ/r² is the constructive law for a point charge (or outside a uniformly charged sphere), which actually brings charge and distance in. Mixing them up is trap two. Field lines are drawn for visualization and are not in the space: electrostatic lines leave positive charge and end on negative, they neither close on themselves nor cross (magnetic lines do close - see the magnetic-field entry), the tangent at a point gives the direction there and the spacing gives the strength. A hard consequence follows: a charge's trajectory generally does not follow a field line, and the two coincide only when the line is straight and the particle starts from rest or straight along it - trap three. A point charge gives straight radial lines; for two equal like charges the field vanishes at the midpoint while the potential does not, and for two equal opposite charges the field is nonzero everywhere along the perpendicular bisector while that bisector itself is an equipotential - this pair is examined almost every year. The tidiest uniform field is the space between two facing parallel plates, bending near the rim (edge effect). The charge-to-mass ratio fixes how fast a particle answers a given field and is the entry point to everything in the mass spectrometer and the cyclotron. Symbols: E field strength, F the force on the test charge, q its charge.

oneLiner: 电势差即电压 U=W/q；沿电场线电势降低。
oneLinerEn: Potential difference is voltage U=W/q; potential drops along field lines.
detail: φ = E_p/q 只由电场本身与位置决定，E_p = qφ 才把电荷也拉进来——一个是场地的属性、一个是双方共同持有，恰似力学里 g 与 mgh 的分工，混用为第一易错。电势可正可负，负号先要问零势点取在哪里（常取大地或无穷远），与选取无关的永远只是差值 U。判断大小只有一条硬规矩：沿电场线电势必然降低；但场强大小与电势高低没有直接关系——场强很大的地方电势可以很低，匀强电场里更是每段相等降落而处处场强相同，这是第二易错。符号要算数：负电荷在电势低处的电势能反而大，所以电子沿着电场线跑时电场力做负功、自己的势能升上去，与常见直觉正相反。等势面与电场线垂直，沿等势面移动电荷电场力不做功；处于静电平衡的导体是一整块等势体，内部场强为零、净电荷只分布在表面（尖端处密集，故有尖端放电与避雷针），内部因此不受外场影响——这就是静电屏蔽，金属网罩、汽车外壳、高压带电作业的均压服与实验室的屏蔽室都靠这一条。鸟停在高压输电线上不会被电击，原因也在这一条：它两爪接触同一根导线，那一段线上的电势差只是毫伏量级；真正危险的是跨步电压：落地电线周围，人前后两脚之间可能承上上百伏，所以要并脚跳离或小步挪开。解题上省力的一笔是：电场叠加要分解矢量，而电势是标量、直接代数相加。常见量级：雷雨前地面附近的场强可达 10⁴ V/m 量级，空气的绝缘强度约 3×10⁶ V/m，即每千伏大约对应几厘米的火花长度。式中 U 为电势差（电压），W 为电场力做的功，q 为电荷电量。
detailEn: φ = E_p/q is fixed by the field and the place alone, while E_p = qφ brings the charge in as well - one is a property of the terrain, the other is held jointly, exactly the division of labour between g and mgh in mechanics; confusing them is trap one. Potential can be negative, but the minus sign first asks where you set the zero (usually the earth or infinity), and only the difference U is independent of that choice. There is one hard rule for ranking: potential must fall along a field line. But field strength and potential height are not tied together - a very strong field can sit at low potential, and in a uniform field every equal step drops the same amount while the field never changes, which is trap two. Signs must actually be counted: a negative charge has more potential energy where the potential is lower, so an electron travelling along a field line has the field doing negative work and its energy rising, against the usual intuition. Equipotential surfaces are perpendicular to field lines and no work is done moving along one; a conductor in electrostatic equilibrium is one equipotential lump with zero internal field and all net charge on its surface (crowded at points, hence point discharge and the lightning rod), so its interior is cut off from outside fields - which is electrostatic shielding, the trick behind a wire mesh cage, a car body, the conductive suit worn for live-line work and a shielded laboratory room. This is why a bird perched on a high-voltage line survives - both feet share one wire whose drop is millivolts - while step voltage is genuinely dangerous, since a fallen line can put a hundred volts between a person's two feet, so one retreats with feet together or in tiny shuffles. The saving move in problems: superposing fields needs vector decomposition, but potential is a scalar and simply adds. For scale: the field near the ground before a thunderstorm can reach 10⁴ V/m, and air breaks down near 3 × 10⁶ V/m, i.e. a few centimetres of spark per kilovolt. Symbols: U potential difference (voltage), W the work done by the electric force, q the charge.

oneLiner: 电容器储存电荷的本领：C=Q/U。
oneLinerEn: A capacitor's ability to store charge: C=Q/U.
detail: C = Q/U 是比值定义法：电容由结构与介质决定，不随带电量与电压变化，正如电阻不随 U、I 变化——定义式、决定式、计算式要分得清。平行板决定式 C = εS/(4πkd)（写成 C = ε_rε₀S/d 等价）给出三个把手：面积、间距、介质。先算一笔数量级的账：1 cm² 的正对方片、隔 1 mm 空气，电容只有约 0.89 pF，这就是电子线路里电容常以皮法、微法计的原因。两条状态必须辨清：一直连着电源则 U 不变，拉开极板（d 升、C 降、Q 与 E 都跟着降）；充完电断开电源则 Q 不变，拉开极板时 U 反而升高，且板间场强不变（把 C 与 Q 代回 E = U/d 后得 4πkQ/(εS)，与 d 无关），这是最常见的易错点。储存的能量 W = ½CU²：充电要克服斥力做功、放电全部交出，所以电容是储能器件。介质被强电场电离后就不再绝缘，称为击穿，故每个电容都有耐压值（标称容量与耐压是两个数字）。实际器件中电解电容有正负极、接反会鼓包甚至爆裂；超级电容靠双电层把有效间距压到纳米量级，容量能到数千法拉、充放极快、循环寿命长，但耐压只有几伏、能量密度远低于锂电池，因此当不了储能主力，只在刹车能量回收与需要瞬间大电流的场合干活。应用面也很宽：收音机调谐、单相电机启动、断电后短时供电、指纹识别与触控屏都靠它；说电容“通交流、隔直流”并不是电荷穿过了介质，而是极板上电荷来回移动的等效效果。式中 C 为电容，Q 为极板带电量，U 为电压，ε 为介电常数，S 为极板面积，d 为间距。
detailEn: C = Q/U is a ratio definition: capacitance is set by geometry and dielectric, not by how much charge or voltage happens to be present, just as resistance does not depend on U and I - keep definition, construction and calculation formulas apart. The parallel-plate law C = εS/(4πkd) (equivalently ε_rε₀S/d) offers three handles: area, spacing, dielectric. Do the scale book first: two 1 cm² squares 1 mm apart in air give about 0.89 pF, which is why circuit capacitors are quoted in picofarads and microfarads. Two regimes must be told apart. Kept wired to the supply, U is fixed, so pulling the plates apart lowers C, Q and E together; charged then disconnected, Q is fixed, so pulling the plates raises U while the field between them does not change at all (substituting into E = U/d leaves 4πkQ/(εS), independent of d) - the single most common trap. Stored energy is W = ½CU²: charging means working against repulsion, discharging hands it all back, so a capacitor is an energy device. Once a strong field ionises the dielectric it stops insulating - breakdown - hence every capacitor has a withstand rating, and nominal capacitance and withstand voltage are two different numbers. Electrolytic capacitors have polarity and will swell or burst if reversed; supercapacitors squeeze the effective gap to nanometres with a double layer, reaching thousands of farads with very fast charge and long cycle life, yet only a few volts of withstand and an energy density far below lithium cells, so they cannot be the main store and serve instead in brake-energy recovery and places needing a sudden burst of current. The uses are broad: radio tuning, single-phase motor starting, brief hold-up after power loss, fingerprint and touch screens. Saying a capacitor 'passes AC and blocks DC' is not charge crossing the dielectric but the equivalent effect of charge shuffling on the plates. Symbols: C capacitance, Q plate charge, U voltage, ε permittivity, S plate area, d the gap.

oneLiner: 电流 I=Q/t；电阻 R=U/I；欧姆定律 U=IR。
oneLinerEn: Current I=Q/t; resistance R=U/I; Ohm's law U=IR.
detail: 先区分两条电阻公式：R = U/I 是定义式（适用于任何导体，包括非线性元件），R = ρL/S 才是决定式，它把材料、长度与截面带进来。欧姆定律本身也有适用条件：金属与电解液导电成立，气体导电、二极管等非线性元件不成立，这类元件只能看伏安特性曲线取点。电阻随温度变：金属的随温度上升（钨丝从常温到工作温度电阻可涨十几倍，故白炽灯绝大多数都在开灯瞬间烧掉——冷态电流冲击最大），碳与半导体则相反，某些合金几乎不变而用作标准电阻与电热丝。超导是另一件事：降到临界温度以下电阻突降为零，但电流或磁场一旦超过临界值就恢复，而且不是所有材料都有这一档。第二组易错在电动势与路端电压：电动势 ε 描述电源把其他形式的能变成电能的本领、由电源本身定；路端电压 U = ε − Ir 随电流增大而下降，所以下午用电高峰时灯会略暗。12 V 的电池内阻 0.5 Ω、输出 1 A 时路端只剩 11.5 V，短路时电流高达 24 A 而路端为零——这就是短路最伤电源、也最容易起火的原因。电流定义 I = Q/t 只问每秒过截面多少电荷：金属里电子的漂移速率仅毫米每秒量级，但电场建立的信号传递接近光速，按下开关灯亮并不是电子从开关跑到了灯泡。电表改装的两个思路都由它来：串大电阻分压做成电压表，并小电阻分流做成电流表，内核都是同一个灵敏电流计。式中 I 为电流，Q 为电荷量，t 为时间，R 为电阻，U 为电压，ρ 为电阻率，L 为长度，S 为横截面积。
detailEn: Separate the two resistance formulas first: R = U/I is the definition (it works for any conductor, even a nonlinear one), while R = ρL/S is the construction law bringing in material, length and section. Ohm's law itself has a domain: metals and electrolytes obey it, gas discharge and diodes do not, and those must be read off their current-voltage curve instead. Resistance moves with temperature. In metals it rises - a tungsten filament goes up more than tenfold from cold to working heat, which is why most incandescent bulbs die at the instant of switching, when the cold surge is largest; carbon and semiconductors go the other way; some alloys barely move and are used for standard resistors and heating wire. Superconductivity is a different story: below a critical temperature resistance collapses to zero, but exceed the critical current or field and it returns, and not every material has this branch at all. The second trap is electromotive force against terminal voltage: ε describes the source's ability to turn other energy into electrical energy and is set by the source, while U = ε − Ir falls as current grows, which is why lamps dim slightly at the evening peak. A 12 V cell with 0.5 Ω internal resistance shows 11.5 V while delivering 1 A, and on short circuit the current reaches 24 A with zero volts at the terminals - hence the damage and the fire risk. I = Q/t only asks how much charge crosses a section per second; in a metal electrons drift at millimetres per second, yet the signal that turns a lamp on travels near light speed, so switching on is not electrons arriving from the switch. Two instrument conversions follow: add a large series resistor to divide voltage and you get a voltmeter, add a small shunt to divide current and you get an ammeter, both built around the same sensitive galvanometer. Symbols: I current, Q charge, t time, R resistance, U voltage, ρ resistivity, L length, S cross-section.

oneLiner: 串联电流相等、电压分压；并联电压相等、电流分流。
oneLinerEn: Series: same current, shared voltage; parallel: same voltage, shared current.
detail: 串联只有一条通路：各处电流相等 I₁=I₂，总电压等于各段之和 U=U₁+U₂，总电阻相加 R=R₁+R₂——n 个相同电阻串起来总阻变 nR，相当于把导体拉长，道理在 R=ρL/S 里。并联两端电压相等，总电流为各支路之和，电阻的倒数相加：两个相同电阻并联得 R/2（相当于截面积翻倍），一般两个电阻用更顺手的 R₁R₂/(R₁+R₂)；分流与阻值成反比，阻大的支路反而流得少。判串并的笨办法最可靠：从电源正极走一遍，只有一条路不回头就是串联，出现分支就是并联；短路则是给电流架了一座几乎零阻的“桥”，几乎全部电荷从桥上走、被短路的用电器就停了。生活用电一律并联，理由就是那两条：每个用电器都要拿到额定的 220 V，且关掉一盏不能带着别的一起灭；串联看着省线，其实一个断开全断、电压还要按阻值分摊。滑动变阻器的两种接法分工写得很清楚：限流接法（串在回路里）简单、本身耗电少，但负载电压调不到零；分压接法（三个接线柱全用上）能从零连续调到接近满值，代价是接线复杂、要多耗一些电，所以下限必须到零、或待测电阻远大于变阻器总阻时就得用分压。等效思路在此最管用：把外部网络逐步化成“一个电阻”，而电源的电动势与内阻始终不变。另外记住电表不是理想器件——电压表内阻极大但并非无穷，电流表内阻极小但并非为零，把表接进电路就已改变了电路，这是读数与误差题的总根源。式中 R 为电阻，U 为电压，I 为电流，下标 1、2 指两段（或两条支路）。
detailEn: Series has one path only: current is the same everywhere, I₁ = I₂, the voltages add, U = U₁ + U₂, and resistances add, R = R₁ + R₂ - putting n equal resistors in series gives nR, which is simply lengthening the conductor, and the reason lives in R = ρL/S. Parallel shares one voltage, the currents add, and reciprocals add: two equal resistors in parallel give R/2 (that is doubling the cross-section), and for the general pair R₁R₂/(R₁ + R₂) is handier; current divides in inverse proportion to resistance, so the larger branch carries less. The plainest reliable test is to walk from the positive terminal: one path with no branching is series, any fork is parallel; a short circuit is a near-zero-resistance bridge thrown across the current, which almost all of it takes, and the bypassed device simply stops. Household wiring is parallel for exactly those two reasons: every appliance must see its rated 220 V, and switching one lamp off must not take the others with it. Series looks economical until one break stops everything and the voltage has to be shared out by resistance. A rheostat has two hookups with clear division of labour: limiting (in series with the load) is simple and wasteful of nothing but cannot bring the load voltage to zero; dividing (all three terminals used) runs continuously from zero to nearly full, at the cost of a messier wiring and extra dissipation - so whenever the lower bound must be zero, or the device under test far exceeds the rheostat's total resistance, use the dividing hook. The equivalent-circuit habit is what pays here: collapse the external network step by step into one resistor, while the emf and internal resistance of the source never change. And remember meters are not ideal - a voltmeter's resistance is huge but not infinite, an ammeter's tiny but not zero - so plugging a meter in has already altered the circuit, which is the root of all instrument-error questions. Symbols: R resistance, U voltage, I current, subscripts 1 and 2 marking the two elements.

detail: 三条公式的身份必须先分开：电功 W = UIt、电功率 P = UI 是普遍式，任何电路都算的是“输入了多少电能”；只有纯电阻电路里才能改写为 P = I²R = U²/R。非纯电阻（电动机、充电中的电池）必须分开算：P_输入 = UI、P_热 = I²R、P_机械 = UI − I²R。举一笔账：额定电压 220 V、线圈电阻 10 Ω 的电动机正常工作时输入 500 W，若误用 P = U²/R 会得到 4840 W——它不是电阻，电能大部分变成了机械能而不是热，这是本条最大的易错点。生活里电功的单位不是焦耳而是千瓦时（kW·h，俗称一度电），1 kW·h = 3.6×10⁶ J，1000 W 的电器开一小时就是一度，电费单读的是这个数而不是 J。额定值与实际值是另一对概念：铭牌上写的是额定电压、额定功率，实际功率由外加电压决定，灯泡上“220 V 25 W”与“220 V 100 W”串联时反而 25 W 的更亮，因为电阻 R = U²/P_额 更大、而串联时实际功率 P_实 = I²R 只看电流与电阻——这句与力学功率条的“额定功率是长时间输出的上限”同口径。保险丝与空气开关都是保护：前者用电阻率较大、熔点较低的合金，电流超额定值就因 I²R 发热自动熔断切断电路，因此额定电流要选得稍大于正常工作电流，且绝对不能用铜丝铁丝替代（铜丝电阻小、熔点高，电流再大也不断，反而失去保护）。用电安全另有两条：金属外壳必须接地，一旦内部绝缘破损外壳带电，短路电流会被空气开关跳断而不经过人体；插座回路上另装漏电保护器，它比较火线与零线的电流，不平衡超过约 30 mA 就在几十毫秒内断开；大功率与金属外壳电器（空调、电热水器）最忌与人体同时接触。式中 W 为电功，P 为电功率，U 为电压，I 为电流，t 为时间，R 为电阻。
detailEn: Separate the three formulas by identity first: W = UIt and P = UI are universal and count energy delivered to any circuit; only inside a pure resistance may they be rewritten as P = I²R = U²/R. For anything else - a motor, a charging cell - keep the books apart: P_in = UI, P_heat = I²R, P_mechanical = UI − I²R. One tally makes the point: a motor rated 220 V with 10 Ω of winding resistance drawing 500 W in normal work would give 4840 W if you misapplied U²/R, because it is not a resistor and most of the energy leaves as shaft work, not heat. That is the biggest trap in this entry. At home the unit of electrical work is not the joule but the kilowatt-hour (kW·h, one 'unit' on the meter), with 1 kW·h = 3.6 × 10⁶ J: a 1000 W appliance for one hour is one unit, and that is what the bill reads. Rated and actual are another pair: the plate gives rated voltage and rated power, while actual power follows the applied voltage - so a '220 V 25 W' and a '220 V 100 W' lamp wired in series burn the other way round, since R = U²/P_rated is larger for the 25 W one and in series the actual P = I²R cares only about current and resistance (same reading as the mechanics entry's 'rated power is the ceiling it may sustain for hours'). Fuses and breakers are both protection: a fuse is an alloy of high resistivity and low melting point that melts by its own I²R heating above the rated current, so its rating is chosen somewhat above the working current, and substituting copper or iron wire destroys the protection entirely, since those carry huge currents without melting. Two safety rules follow from the same arithmetic: metal cases must be earthed, so that a failed insulation shorts to ground and trips the breaker instead of going through a person; and it is worst to touch a large metal-cased appliance (air conditioner, storage heater) while also touching ground; socket circuits carry a further device, the residual-current breaker, which compares the current going out and coming back and cuts off within tens of milliseconds once the imbalance exceeds some 30 mA. Symbols: W electrical work, P power, U voltage, I current, t time, R resistance.

detail: Q = I²Rt 是电热（焦耳热）的量热公式，由实验定出。两条用法界线要先划清：纯电阻电路里电能全部变热，W = UIt 与 Q = I²Rt 相等；电动机、充电中的电池这类电能主要变成其他形式的能，则 W > Q，此时用 Q = I²Rt 只算发热那一部分，而 U²t/R 不适用。散热也是账的一部分：电热器（电饭锅、电烙铁、电暖器）要把热量尽量留下，故用绝热与减小散热面积；电动机与变压器反而要压住热，靠风扇、散热片与油浸，因为发热就是绝缘老化与效率损失。远距离输电最能体现这条公式的分量：线损 P_损 = I²R_线，减小损耗有两条路——换粗导线与降电流；把输电线的电阻降到零不现实，所以工程上靠升压来降电流：输送功率 P 一定时 I = P/U，电压升到 10 倍电流即降到十分之一，线损按平方降到百分之一。我国电网发电站先升到 110〜500 kV 的高压交流、部分线路用到 1000 kV 特高压交流，直流输电则常取 ±800〜±1100 kV（直流无感抗且适合远距离与跨海）。热功当量由焦耳本人 1840 年代用砝码带动桨叶搅拌水的实验确定，1 cal = 4.184 J，电热与机械能在能量守恒上等价。两处易错：一、“热量”是过程量，符号用 Q 不能用 q，也不能说物体“含有多少热量”；二、算出的温度上升是理想上限，实际散热快、水吸热不完全，计算值总比真实偏高。式中 Q 为电热，I 为电流，R 为电阻，t 为通电时间。
detailEn: Q = I²Rt is the heating law, fixed by experiment. Draw the two boundaries first: in a pure resistance all delivered energy becomes heat, so W = UIt and Q = I²Rt coincide; in a motor or a charging cell most of it becomes something else, so W > Q, and Q = I²Rt then counts only the heat while U²t/R does not apply. Losing heat is part of the book too: heaters (rice cookers, soldering irons, panel heaters) try to keep their heat with insulation and small radiating area, while motors and transformers try to dump it, with fans, fins and oil, because heat is ageing insulation and lost efficiency. Long-distance transmission shows the formula's weight best: the loss is I²R_line, and there are two ways down - thicker wire, or less current. Making the line resistance vanish is not on the table, so the trade is to raise the voltage: with P fixed, I = P/U, and ten times the voltage is a tenth of the current, hence one hundredth of the loss by the square. Grids step generation up to 110-500 kV alternating current, some lines reaching 1000 kV ultra-high, while direct-current links run at ±800 to ±1100 kV (no reactance, and best over long distances and under sea). The mechanical equivalent of heat was measured by Joule himself in the 1840s by falling weights turning paddles in water, giving 1 cal = 4.184 J, and putting electrical and mechanical energy on one conservation account. Two traps: heat is a process quantity, written Q and never spoken of as something a body 'contains'; and any computed temperature rise is an ideal ceiling, since real setups lose heat and absorb imperfectly, so the calculation overshoots. Symbols: Q the heat generated, I current, R resistance, t the time of flow.

oneLiner: 磁体、电流周围存在磁场；可用安培定则判断方向。
oneLinerEn: Magnets and currents create magnetic fields; use the right-hand rule for direction.
detail: 磁场与电场同为客观存在的物质，但两者的场线形态根本不同：磁感线是闭合曲线，外部由 N 极到 S 极、内部由 S 回到 N，因此没有磁单极——把一条形磁铁掰断，得到的是两块新的完整磁铁而不是两个磁极（这一点与力学里“正负电荷可分开”形成对照）。方向判定统一交给安培定则（右手螺旋）：直导线用拇指指电流、四指卷向即磁感线环绕方向；环形与螺线管则四指顺电流、拇指指轴线上的 N 极，这一步也是判断电磁铁磁极与继电器动作方向的第一步。历史脉络很紧凑：1820 年奥斯特发现通电导线能让小磁针偏转，是人类第一次看到电与磁有联系；紧接着安培把问题换成“电流与电流也相互作用”（同向相吸、反向相斥，见安培力条），并主张磁就是物质内部的分子环流，从此不必假想两种磁荷。地磁是最有用的一个实例：地球相当于一个大磁体，而地理北极附近其实是地磁场的 S 极（正因如此磁针的 N 端才被吸向北，口径与“异名磁极相吸”一致）；磁偏角（磁北与真北之差）在我国宋代沈括《梦溪笔谈》（1088 年前后）已有明确记载，同书还记下了指南针的水浮、缕悬、碗唇、指甲四种装置法；哥伦布 1492 年横渡大西洋时也在海上实测到了它；地磁两极与地理两极不重合、且长期在漂移。强度上地磁场约 5×10⁻⁵ T（即 0.5 高斯），而实验室电磁铁可达 1 T 以上、医用磁共振设备常见 1.5〜3 T，相差四个数量级以上。两个常考对照：两条通同向电流的导线在中点的合磁场为零（而中垂线上其他地方不为零）；小磁针静止时 N 极指的方向即该点磁场方向，与它“S 极指的方向”相对。式中 B 为磁感应强度（T），方向定义为小磁针 N 极受力方向。
detailEn: A magnetic field is as objective as an electric one, but its line pattern differs fundamentally: magnetic lines are closed curves, running N to S outside a magnet and S back to N inside, so there is no magnetic monopole - snap a bar magnet and you get two new complete magnets, not two separated poles (contrast this with plus and minus charge, which can be pulled apart). Direction is settled by one rule, Ampère's right-hand grip: for a straight wire point the thumb along the current and the curled fingers give the sense of the lines; for a loop or solenoid curl the fingers with the current and the thumb points to the N pole along the axis - the first move for any electromagnet or relay question. The history is tight: in 1820 Oersted showed a current-carrying wire swings a compass needle, the first human witness of a link between electricity and magnetism, and within days Ampère had changed the question to currents acting on currents (like directions attract, opposite repel - see the ampere-force entry), arguing that magnetism simply is molecular circulation inside matter, so no two kinds of magnetic fluid need be assumed. Geomagnetism is the most useful example: the Earth behaves like a big magnet, and near the geographic north sits the south pole of that field - which is exactly why a needle's north end is pulled northway, consistent with 'unlike poles attract'. Magnetic declination, the angle between magnetic and true north, was recorded clearly in China by Shen Kuo in the Dream Pool Essays around 1088, where he also lists four ways of mounting a compass needle (floating on water, hanging by a silk thread, on a bowl rim, on a fingernail), and Columbus measured it at sea in 1492; the geomagnetic poles do not coincide with the rotation poles and drift steadily. For scale the field here is about 5 × 10⁻⁵ T (0.5 gauss) while a laboratory electromagnet tops 1 T and medical MRI runs 1.5-3 T, four or more orders apart. Two standard comparisons: two parallel wires carrying the same current give zero net field at their midpoint (but not elsewhere on the bisector), and a needle at rest points its N end along the field, its S end against it. Symbols: B magnetic flux density in tesla, defined as the direction of the force on a north pole.

oneLiner: 通电导线在磁场中受力：F=BIL·sinθ。
oneLinerEn: A current-carrying wire feels F=BIL·sinθ in a field.
detail: F = BIL 只适用于匀强磁场中且直导线与磁场垂直，不垂直时取分量 F = BIL·sinθ；θ = 0（导线与磁场平行）则受力为零，这一点常被忽略。方向用左手定则：磁感线穿入手心、四指指电流方向、拇指即受力方向。本条要与磁场条的右手螺旋分工清楚——右手判“电流造出的磁场”，左手判“磁场给电流的力”。安培力其实是洛伦兹力的宏观表现：F = BIL 与导体内每个载流子受的 f = qvB 数量上能对上（以 n 为单位体积载流子数、S 为截面、L 为长度，则总载流子数 N = nSL，合力为 N·qvB 形式而 v 的漂移量级刚好使结果归回 BIL），这也是下面霍尔效应的入口。电动机是本公式最要紧的应用：线圈在磁场中受安培力而转动，靠换向器与电刷在每个半周把电流反向以保证转矩不反向；而一旦转起来，线圈又在磁场中切割磁感线、产生一个与外加电压反向的电动势（反电动势），它就是电动机不能用欧姆定律简单取 I = U/R 的原因（起动瞬间没有反电动势，所以起动电流最大，与照明灯开灯即烧是同一类事）。两条通流导线之间的安培力（同向相吸、反向相斥）是安培单位的历史定义：1948 年国际计量大会把安培写作相距 1 m 的无限长平行导线间每米 2×10⁻⁷ N 的力，2019 年改由基本电荷的固定数值给出（与安培人物条同口径）。工程上另两处用到它：扬声器靠音圈受力带动纸盆，磁电式电表靠安培力力矩平衡游丝力矩。易错点是受力方向、电流方向、磁场方向三者两两垂直，已知两个求第三个才能直接用左手定则。式中 F 为安培力，B 为磁感应强度，I 为电流，L 为导线长度，θ 为电流与磁场方向夹角。
detailEn: F = BIL holds only for a straight wire in a uniform field at right angles to it; otherwise take the component, F = BIL sinθ, and note that the force vanishes when the wire runs parallel to the field - the case most often forgotten. The direction comes from the left-hand rule: let the lines pierce the palm, point the four fingers with the current, and the thumb is the force. Divide the labour with the magnetic-field entry: the right hand judges the field a current makes, the left hand judges the force a field gives a current. Ampère force is in fact the macroscopic face of the Lorentz force, and the two do match numerically through the carriers inside the wire, which is also the doorway to the Hall effect below. The motor is the weightiest application: the coil is pushed by Ampère forces and the commutator with its brushes reverses the current every half turn so that the torque never flips; but once it spins, the coil is cutting lines and raises an emf opposing the supply - the back emf - and this is precisely why a running motor cannot be treated with I = U/R (at standstill there is no back emf, so starting current is largest, the same family of fact as a lamp dying at switch-on). The force between two current-carrying wires, attracting when parallel, was also the historical definition of the unit: in 1948 the metre-kilogram-second community wrote the ampere as the current giving 2 × 10⁻⁷ N per metre between one metre apart infinite parallel wires, and since 2019 it follows from a fixed elementary charge instead (as the Ampère biography entry states). Two further uses: a loudspeaker's voice coil drives a cone by this force, and a moving-coil meter balances it against a hairspring. The trap is geometry: force, current and field are mutually perpendicular, so the left hand works only when two of the three are known. Symbols: F Ampère force, B flux density, I current, L wire length, θ the angle between current and field.

oneLiner: 运动电荷在磁场中受力：f=qvB·sinθ，方向用左手定则。
oneLinerEn: A moving charge feels f=qvB·sinθ, direction by the left-hand rule.
detail: 洛伦兹力永远与速度垂直，因此只改方向不改速率、对粒子不做功，动能不变——这是本条第一句要立的口径。v 与 B 垂直时粒子做匀速圆周，r = mv/(qB)、T = 2πm/(qB)，而周期与速率无关：快粒子半径大、走得远，但一圈用的时间相同。回旋加速器就靠这一点工作——磁场只负责把粒子带回缝隙，加速全部由缝隙里的交变电场完成，每过缝一次加一笔能；但粒子快到相对论效应显著时，质量上升使周期变长、与固定频率失步，因此能量上限受限，得改用同步加速器或同步调整频率。由半径公式反解就得到质谱的原理：同速的离子按 m/q 分半径，氘核半径是质子的两倍，分离同位素靠的就是这一笔（v = 1×10⁶ m/s、B = 0.5 T 时质子的圆半径约 21 cm）。速度选择器让电场力与磁场力相抵，qE = qvB 即 v = E/B，与电量、质量、速率都无关，只选速度；反过来看，带电粒子进入匀强磁场后若能回到原高度，中间一定发生过与壁的弹性碰撞，这是题型而非现实。把 v 分解成垂直与平行于 B 的两个分量，就得到螺旋轨道；沿磁力线方向的分量不变、垂直分量绕圈，因此磁场能把发散的粒子束“箍”回轴向，称磁聚焦（托卡马克的磁面约束与此同理）。霍尔效应则是本公式在固体里的直接后果：电流与磁场垂直时载流子被侧向挤到一侧，在两侧建立起电压 U_H = IB/(nqd)（d 为沿磁场方向的厚度），由此可判载流子种类（电压反向即说明是空穴）、测浓度（金属 n 约 10²⁹ 每立方米、霍尔电压极小，半导体 n 约 10²³ 反而明显，故霍尔探头都用半导体）。易错点在方向：负电荷受力与左手定则所指四向相反，要取反向。式中 f 为洛伦兹力，q 为电荷量，v 为速度，B 为磁感应强度，θ 为速度与磁场方向夹角。
detailEn: The Lorentz force is always perpendicular to the velocity, so it turns speed aside without changing it and does no work - kinetic energy is untouched, and that is the first thing to settle. With v at right angles to B the path is a circle of radius r = mv/(qB) and period T = 2πm/(qB), and the period does not depend on speed: a faster particle rides a wider circle yet takes the same time per turn. The cyclotron lives on that fact - the magnet only brings the particle back to the gap, and all acceleration is done by an alternating electric field across the gap, one top-up per crossing; but once relativistic mass gain stretches the period the fixed frequency falls out of step, which caps the energy and forces the synchrotron or a swept frequency instead. Solving the radius formula backwards gives the mass spectrometer: ions of equal speed separate by m/q, a deuteron turning out at twice the proton's radius, which is how isotopes are parted (about 21 cm for a proton at v = 1 × 10⁶ m/s in 0.5 T). A velocity selector cancels electric against magnetic force, qE = qvB, i.e. v = E/B, independent of charge, mass and everything else but speed. Split v into parts perpendicular and parallel to B and the path becomes a helix: the parallel part is untouched while the perpendicular part circles, so a magnetic field gathers a spreading beam back onto the axis - magnetic focusing, the same idea behind magnetic confinement in a tokamak. The Hall effect is the formula's consequence inside solids: with current and field perpendicular, carriers are shoved to one face until a transverse voltage U_H = IB/(nqd) balances it (d being the thickness along the field), which identifies carrier sign (a reversed voltage means holes) and measures their density - about 10²⁹ per cubic metre in metals, where the voltage is minute, and around 10²³ in semiconductors, where it is obvious, which is why every Hall probe is a semiconductor. The trap is direction: for a negative charge the force is opposite to what the left hand indicates. Symbols: f Lorentz force, q charge, v speed, B flux density, θ the angle between v and B.

oneLiner: 磁通量变化产生感应电动势：法拉第定律与楞次定律。
oneLinerEn: Changing flux induces EMF: Faraday's and Lenz's laws.
detail: 先定研究对象：磁通量 Φ = BS 是穿过回路的磁感线条数（B 与面垂直时；不垂直取投影 Φ = BS·cosα），它是标量但有正负（穿入穿出）。产生感应电动势的唯一条件是回路磁通量发生变化，与磁通量本身多大无关—— Φ 很大而不变时反而没有感应，这是第一处易错。大小由法拉第定律给：ε = n·ΔΦ/Δt（n 为匝数），导体棒切割磁感线则是它的特例 ε = BLv（要求 B、L、v 三者两两垂直，不垂直时取分量）。算一笔账：100 匝线圈在 0.1 s 内把磁通从 0.02 Wb 变到 0.08 Wb，得 ε = 60 V。方向由楞次定律定，而它的实质是能量守恒——感应电流的效果总是反抗引起它的那个原因：靠近则拒、远离则留（“来拒去留”），磁铁穿过竖直铜管会明显缓慢下落就是这个道理（涡流阻尼），也是磁悬浮刹车与电磁阻尼式电表指针迅速停摆的原因。判方向的完整口径是五步：定原磁场方向 → 判磁通增还是减 → 用楞次定律定感应磁场（增反减同）→ 再用安培定则找感应电流。这里的安培定则（右手螺旋）用于线圈回路，而导体棒切割时另有一条“右手定则”：掌心迎磁感线、拇指指导体运动方向、四指即感应电流方向；两者分工不同，此前缺字的这两个术语在此一并补上。应用分三支：发电机与动圈话筒是“动生”，变压器与无线充电是“感生”；涡流的另一面就是感应炉与电磁炉——高频交变磁场在锅底同时产生涡流与磁滞损耗而发热，所以铁质导磁锅效果好、铝锅与玻璃陶瓷基本不行。式中 ε 为感应电动势，n 为线圈匝数，Φ 为磁通量（Wb），t 为时间。
detailEn: Fix the object first: flux Φ = BS counts the lines crossing a loop (for B perpendicular to the face; otherwise project, Φ = BS cosα). It is a scalar with a sign, in against out. The one condition for an induced emf is that the flux changes, no matter how large it is - a big but steady flux induces nothing, which is trap one. The size comes from Faraday, ε = n·ΔΦ/Δt, and the moving rod's ε = BLv is its special case (requiring B, L and v mutually perpendicular, else take components). A tally: 100 turns whose flux runs from 0.02 Wb to 0.08 Wb in 0.1 s give 60 V. The direction comes from Lenz, whose substance is energy conservation - the induced current always fights the cause that made it, refusing an approach and clinging to a departure ('oppose the coming, oppose the going'), which is why a magnet falls visibly slowly through a vertical copper tube (eddy-current damping), and why magnetic brakes and dead-beat galvanometer needles settle so fast. The full five-step recipe: name the original field, judge whether flux grows or shrinks, use Lenz for the induced field (opposite if growing, same if shrinking), then use Ampère's right-hand grip for the current. That grip is a different tool from the 'right-hand rule' commonly used for a cutting rod (thumb along motion, fingers along induced current, palm facing the lines): one judges coils, the other judges rods - a terminology gap this entry now closes. Applications split three ways: generators and moving-coil microphones are motion-made, transformers and wireless charging are field-made; and the other face of eddy currents is the induction furnace and the induction hob, where a high-frequency alternating field heats the pan through both eddy current and magnetic hysteresis, which is why a magnetic steel pan works while aluminium, glass and ceramic barely do. Symbols: ε induced emf, n number of turns, Φ flux in weber, t time.

oneLiner: 变化的电场与磁场相互激发，形成传播的电磁波。
oneLinerEn: Changing E and B fields sustain each other as traveling EM waves.
detail: 关键的一步是位移电流：麦克斯韦 1861 年提出“变化的电场也等效为电流”，于是磁场的产生不再只靠传导电流，电磁场才能自洽地向前推进。他从方程组算出电磁波速度 v = 1/√(μ₀ε₀)，代入实验测得的磁常数与电常数后得数恰等于光速，因而得出一个伟大推论：光就是电磁波（与麦克斯韦人物条同口径）。赫兹 1887 年才用感应线圈与开环偶极子把这种波打出来、测到反射折射与驻波，证实了这一点，而他本人只当这是“证明麦克斯韦是对的”，看不出实用价值。电磁波是横波：E 与 B 相互垂直且都垂直于传播方向，E、B 同相振荡；真空中所有频率的电磁波都取同一个速度 c = 3×10⁸ m/s，而波长与频率满足 c = λf，频率越高波长越短。按波长从长到短排序为：无线电波、微波、红外、可见光、紫外、X 射线、γ 射线。几个必须记住的性质：微波波长以厘米计、绕射能力差因而需要视距传播（5G 尤其明显），但它能穿透云雾且使锅底水分子随交变电场反复转向、摩擦生热（教材常简称为共振吸收，微波炉取 2.45 GHz，炉门玻璃下那张金属网就是电磁屏蔽：网孔远小于波长，波过不去而眼睛看得见）；红外线主要就是热效应，容易被水汽与尘埃吸收，因此遥控与夜视都用近红外；可见光只占约 400〜700 nm 很窄一段；紫外线适量能促成维生素 D、过量则伤皮肤与眼，大部分被臭氧层吸收；X 射线由高速电子轰击金属靶产生、穿透力强而电离会致癌，故医学上既要照得透又要挡得住（铅衣）；γ 射线波长最短、来自原子核内部，穿透最强。发射必须满足两个条件：频率足够高且电路开放（见 LC 振荡条），所以低频信号得先“调制”到高频载波上——调幅改振幅、调频改频率；传播中遇到障碍物尺寸与其波长相当时衍射明显，波长越长绕射越强，因此长波能绕山沿海传播、微波只能直线接力。光也是电磁波，所以本条与光学各条其实是同一个谱的不同区段。式中 c 为电磁波速度，λ 为波长，f 为频率。
detailEn: The decisive move was displacement current: in 1861 Maxwell proposed that a changing electric field acts like a current, so making a magnetic field no longer required a conducted current, and the electromagnetic field could push itself forward. From his equations he got v = 1/√(μ₀ε₀); inserting the measured magnetic and electrical constants returned exactly the speed of light, whence the great inference that light is an electromagnetic wave (the same reading as the Maxwell biography entry). Hertz only produced such waves in 1887 with an induction coil, a split copper bar and an open ring, measuring their reflection, refraction and standing waves, and he saw this merely as 'proving Maxwell right' - the famous misjudgement that left radio to others. These waves are transverse: E and B are perpendicular to each other and both perpendicular to the direction of travel, oscillating in step. In vacuum every frequency travels at the same c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, with c = λf, so higher frequency means shorter wavelength. Ordered by decreasing wavelength: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma. The properties worth memorising: microwaves are centimetre-scale, diffract poorly and so need line of sight (very noticeable at 5G), yet pass through cloud and fog and heat food by driving polar water molecules to flip with the alternating field, rubbing them into heat (the textbook shorthand is resonant absorption; a kitchen oven uses 2.45 GHz, and the metal mesh under its door window is electromagnetic shielding - holes far smaller than the wavelength, so the wave cannot pass but the eye can); infrared is mostly heat, readily absorbed by vapour, hence remotes and night vision use the near band; visible light spans only some 400-700 nm; ultraviolet makes vitamin D but damages skin and eyes and is largely absorbed by the ozone layer; X-rays come from fast electrons striking a metal target, penetrate well and ionise cells, so medicine must both see through and shield (lead aprons); gamma rays are shortest of all, born inside the nucleus, and penetrate most. Efficient emission needs high frequency and an open circuit (see the LC entry), so a slow signal must first be modulated onto a carrier - amplitude modulation varies the height, frequency modulation the rate. Diffraction is strong when an obstacle matches the wavelength, so long waves bend round hills and hug the sea while microwaves must be relayed in straight lines. Since light is one of them, this entry and the optics entries describe different stretches of a single spectrum. Symbols: c wave speed, λ wavelength, f frequency.

oneLiner: 电流大小与方向随时间周期性变化，家用电即正弦式交流电。
oneLinerEn: Current whose magnitude and direction cycle over time; mains supply is sinusoidal AC.
detail: 描述交变电流用峰值、有效值、周期与频率四件：正弦式交流电的有效值 I = I_m/√2、U = U_m/√2，我国市电 220 V、50 Hz，即周期 0.02 s、线圈每转一周方向改变两次、每秒方向改变 100 次，而峰值 220×1.41 ≈ 311 V。有效值的定义口径是热效应等效：与它同时间在同电阻上产生相同热量的直流数值，因此电表读数、保险丝额定值与铭牌上写的都是有效值而不是峰值（本条第一易错：误把 220 V 当恒定电压，它的瞬时值在 ±311 V 之间连续变化）。相位与频率是另一组易错点：电容“通交流、隔直流”并不是电荷穿过了介质，而是极板上电荷来回移动的等效电流，其容抗 X_C = 1/(2πfC)，频率越高越容易通过；电感的感抗 X_L = 2πfL，频率越高越阻，因此电感常作阻流与滤波，两者组合就能选频。特别注意：感抗与容抗都不是电阻，不消耗能量，只使电流与电压相位错开（电感上电压超前电流、电容上电压落后电流），所以不能直接拿 I = U/R 去算交流电路的电流，要看阻抗。为什么非要用交流输电：因为交流能变压，而升压可大幅降低线损（见焦耳定律条），所以发电机用交流。与之对照，直流输电因无感抗与容抗损失、且不需同步运行，反而适合超远距离与跨海联网。安全上另要记一句：触电危不危险并不只看有效值，220 V 峰值 311 V 已足以击穿皮肤电阻，而干燥环境下人体电阻可达几千欧、潮湿时降至一千欧以下。式中 I 为有效值，I_m 为峰值。
detailEn: Describe alternating current with peak, rms, period and frequency. For a sine wave the rms values are I = I_m/√2 and U = U_m/√2; the Chinese mains is 220 V at 50 Hz, so the period is 0.02 s, an alternating coil reverses twice per turn and the current flips direction 100 times a second, with a peak of 220 × 1.41 ≈ 311 V. The rms value is defined thermally: the steady current that, in the same resistance and time, gives the same heat - which is why meter readings, fuse ratings and nameplate figures are all rms, not peak (trap one: treating 220 V as a constant, when the instantaneous value swings through ±311 V continuously). Phase and frequency bring the next traps. A capacitor 'passes AC and blocks DC' not because charge crosses the dielectric but because charge shuffles on its plates, an equivalent current; its reactance X_C = 1/(2πfC) shrinks as frequency rises, while an inductor's X_L = 2πfL grows, so inductors choke and filter and the pair together selects frequency. Note well that neither reactance is a resistance: neither spends energy, each only shifts phase - voltage leads current on an inductor, lags it on a capacitor - so I = U/R cannot be used on an AC circuit without going through impedance. Why alternating current for the grid at all: because it can be transformed, and stepping up slashes the line loss (see Joule's law); generators are therefore built as AC machines. By contrast direct-current links, free of reactance losses and of the need to run in step, suit very long distances and undersea interconnection. One safety sentence too: danger does not follow the rms figure alone - the 311 V peak of a 220 V supply is easily enough to break down skin, and a human body measures thousands of ohms when dry but under a thousand when wet. Symbols: I the rms current, I_m the peak.

oneLiner: 利用互感把交流电压升高或降低，理想变压器输入功率等于输出功率。
oneLinerEn: Uses mutual induction to raise or lower AC voltage; an ideal transformer conserves power.
detail: 变压器靠互感工作：原线圈中变化的电流在铁芯里产生变化的磁通，副线圈因这一变化而感应出电动势，因此它只能改变交流电压而不能改变直流（与自感条里法拉第铁环实验“只在通电与断电瞬间有感应”同一道理）。理想变压器的两条关系：电压比等于匝数比 U₁/U₂ = n₁/n₂，而电流比与之相反 I₁/I₂ = n₂/n₁——第二条只能从功率相等得出，漏掉这一步而只算电压比是本条第一大易错。铁芯用硅钢叠片而非整块，是为了压住涡流发热（涡流在整块铁芯里会白白耗能并升温），叠片方向与磁通垂直、电阻大得多；实际变压器总有铜损（线圈电阻发热）与铁损（涡流加磁滞），效率常见 90% 以上，大型电力变压器可达 98% 以上。匝数少的一边电流大，因此用粗导线（高压侧匝数多、线细）。与焦耳定律条联起来就是电网的全部理由：输送功率一定时 I = P/U，电压升十倍则电流降十分之一、线损降百分之一，所以发电站先升到 110〜500 kV，部分线路用 1000 kV 特高压，到用电区再分级降到 10 kV、最后到户用 220 V。升压与降压是同一台机器两个方向的使用，变电站里两种并用；而变压器不能变频率，输出频率与输入相同。另外提醒：自耦变压器（只一个线圈、抽头取压）体积小成本低，但高低压侧直接导电相连、失去绝缘隔离，因而不能用作安全电源。式中 U₁、U₂ 为原副线圈电压，n₁、n₂ 为匝数，I₁、I₂ 为电流。
detailEn: A transformer runs on mutual induction: the changing current in the primary makes a changing flux in the core, and the secondary responds to that change, so it can alter an alternating voltage and nothing at all on a steady direct one (the same lesson as Faraday's iron-ring experiment, where the effect showed only at make and break). The ideal machine gives two relations: voltage follows turns, U₁/U₂ = n₁/n₂, while current runs the other way, I₁/I₂ = n₂/n₁ - and the second is available only from equal power, so forgetting it and stopping at the turns ratio is this entry's first trap. The core is stacked from silicon-steel laminations rather than one solid block in order to choke eddy-current heating; the sheets run across the flux and present a far larger resistance. Real transformers always carry copper loss from the windings and iron loss from eddy current plus hysteresis, with efficiencies above 90 per cent normally and above 98 per cent for large power units. The few-turn side carries the bigger current and is therefore wound with thick wire (the high-voltage side has many turns of thin wire). Read together with Joule's law this is the whole reason grids exist: with power fixed, I = P/U, so ten times the voltage is a tenth of the current and a hundredth of the loss - hence generation stepped up to 110-500 kV, some lines at 1000 kV ultra-high, then stepped down in stages to 10 kV and finally to the 220 V at the socket. Stepping up and stepping down are one machine used in two directions and substations run both; a transformer cannot change frequency, which stays as delivered. One warning: an autotransformer, a single winding with a tap, is small and cheap, but its high and low sides are electrically joined and lose galvanic isolation, so it must not be used as a safe supply. Symbols: U₁, U₂ primary and secondary voltage, n₁, n₂ turns, I₁, I₂ currents.

oneLiner: 导体自身电流变化会在本回路激起感应电动势，两线圈之间则相互感应。
oneLinerEn: A changing current induces EMF in its own circuit (self) and in a neighboring coil (mutual).
detail: 自感是线圈对自己电流变化的反抗：电流一变，自身磁通跟着变，就在同一线圈里激起感应电动势，方向总阻碍原电流的变化（楞次定律是本条一切方向的总口径）。由此两条现象：通电时电流只能逐渐建立、并联的灯泡渐亮；断电时原本稳恒的电流失去通路，却因自感电动势维持而继以短暂电流，故与线圈并联的灯泡会“先闪一下再灭”而不是立即熄灭。电动势大小 ε = L·ΔI/Δt，L 为自感系数、单位亨利：1 H 的线圈若每秒变化 1 A 就激起 1 V；实用线圈常为毫亨量级，日光灯镇流器与电源滤波扼流圈都在此。本条最能伤人的是断电：断开一个大电流电感（汽车点火线圈、大型接触器、变压器带电拔插）时 ΔI/Δt 极大，自感电动势可达数百上千伏，因而拉出火花、击穿开关、电击人手；汽车点火系统正是靠断开点火回路那一瞬间产生的高压去点燃火花塞，而工程上则在线圈两端并接续流二极管给电流一个退路。与之互补的是电感的基本性格“通直流、阻交流，通低频、阻高频”（X_L = 2πfL），因此它在电路里作扼流与滤波，与电容分工相反（电容“通交流、隔直流”）。互感则是把一个线圈的变化交给另一个线圈：变压器与互感拾音头是它的正经应用，无线充电与手机充电板则靠近场互感传递能量，效率高但距离只能到厘米量级，且异物会因涡流发热因而需要检测。另外提醒：自感与互感都不创造能量，磁场能 W = ½LI² 储在线圈里，建立时取、消失时交回。式中 ε 为自感电动势，L 为自感系数（H），ΔI 为电流变化量，Δt 为时间。
detailEn: Self-induction is a coil resisting changes in its own current: change the current, change its flux, and an emf appears in the same coil opposing that change (Lenz's law is the one reading for every direction here). Two everyday consequences follow. On making, the current can only grow gradually and the lamp brightens slowly; on breaking, the steady current loses its path but is held briefly by the self-induced emf, so a lamp wired across the coil flashes out rather than vanishing. The size is ε = L·ΔI/Δt, with L the self-inductance in henries: one henry returns one volt per ampere per second, while practical coils sit in millihenries - a fluorescent-lamp ballast and a supply choke both live there. The breaking case is the dangerous one. Cut a heavy-current inductance (a car ignition coil, a heavy contactor, a transformer under load) and ΔI/Δt is enormous, the emf reaches hundreds or thousands of volts, so it throws a spark, burns the switch and can strike a hand; an ignition system relies on exactly that voltage spike to fire the plug, while engineers clamp a free-wheeling diode across the coil to give the current somewhere to go. The complementary character of an inductor is 'passes DC, blocks AC; passes low frequency, blocks high' (X_L = 2πfL), which is why it serves as choke and filter, the opposite of a capacitor's 'passes AC, blocks DC'. Mutual induction hands one coil's change to another: transformers and pickup coils are its proper work, while wireless and phone charging pads carry energy by near-field mutual coupling - efficient but only over centimetres, and foreign objects heat up by eddy current, which is why they must be detected. Neither kind of induction creates energy: the magnetic store is W = ½LI², taken while building up and handed back on collapse. Symbols: ε self-induced emf, L inductance in henry, ΔI the current change, Δt the time.

term: 电磁振荡与电磁波发射
oneLiner: 电容与电感回路中电场能与磁场能周期互转，产生高频振荡，是发射电磁波的基础。
oneLinerEn: In an LC circuit electric and magnetic energy trade periodically, giving high-frequency oscillation—the basis of emitting EM waves.
detail: LC 回路的振荡是能量在电场与磁场之间来回交接：电容放完电后电流不会停，线圈的自感维持它继续流动、反过来给电容充满反向电压，于是这样来回交替。T = 2π√(LC)、f = 1/(2π√(LC))，L 与 C 越小频率越高；振荡过程中电流与电荷相位错开四分之一个周期（电荷最大时电流为零，反之亦反），恰好与力学里弹簧振子的位移与速度同构。理想回路无阻尼会一直振荡，实际线圈有电阻，能量以 I²R 热损失而振荡衰减（阻尼），要维持等幅必须靠晶体管不断补能——这就是电子振荡器的本质。要有效辐射需两个条件：频率足够高与电路足够开放，把极板张开、让电场散到空间中去，因此低频信号不能直接发射，得先“驮”到高频载波上——这就是调制：调幅改振幅、调频改频率，调谐与选台其实是同一件事：改变回路里的可变电容器，让固有频率与目标电台一致而发生电谐振（与力学受迫振动条同口径，只是能量交换发生在电磁回路里）。天线尺寸与工作波长相关，半波长偶极子最常见：100 MHz 的调频广播波长 3 m，常用天线约 1.5 m（或四分之一波长约 0.75 m）。发射与接收分别在这回路两端：发射要开放电路与高频、接收靠调谐与解调把信号从载波上取下来。式中 f 为振荡频率，L 为电感，C 为电容。
detailEn: Oscillation in an LC circuit is energy handed back and forth between field forms: when the capacitor has discharged the current does not stop, because the coil's self-inductance drives it on and charges the capacitor up in reverse, and the account keeps turning. T = 2π√(LC) and f = 1/(2π√(LC)), so the smaller L and C, the higher the frequency; during the swing charge and current are a quarter period out of step (charge peaks where current vanishes and the other way round), exactly the same structure as displacement against velocity in a spring oscillator. An ideal circuit would oscillate forever, but a real coil has resistance, energy leaves as I²R heat and the swing decays (damping); holding constant amplitude means a transistor topping it up continuously - which is what an electronic oscillator is. Efficient radiation asks two things, high frequency and an open circuit that spreads its field into space, so a slow signal cannot be broadcast directly and must be lifted onto a carrier: modulation, amplitude or frequency. Tuning and station selection are one thing - vary the capacitor until the circuit's natural frequency matches the target station and electrical resonance takes hold (the same reading as forced oscillation in mechanics, only the energy exchange here is electromagnetic). Antenna size follows the wavelength, with the half-wave dipole most common: an FM station at 100 MHz has a 3 m wavelength, so antennas near 1.5 m, or a quarter-wave at 0.75 m, are usual. Emission and reception sit at the two ends of this circuit - the transmitter needs high frequency and openness, the receiver needs tuning plus demodulation to take the message off the carrier.
